page.description: pfSense editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: Netgate's FreeBSD-based firewall and router, published in two trains: the open-source Community Edition (CE) and the commercial pfSense Plus. The installed system is chosen at install time, not baked into the media.
pros: Full firewall, VPN, routing and traffic shaping in one web interface.
FreeBSD base with a long security record.
CE is open source; Plus adds commercial features and support.
cons: Current media sizes are not published and the commercial installer sits behind a store checkout.
The CE download paths published by name returned 404 when checked.
No end-of-life dates are published; support state is an icon in a table.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for pfSense; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Netgate distributes the installer images itself: Plus images come from its store, and the CE file names on the download page resolve through the same funnel. This page is a signpost; ROMinit pins nothing.
